Hiring manager asked for a hybrid format: 30 min ML systems discussion + 50 min coding probe with a short system design follow-up.

Can the interview team confirm availability for 2028-04-10 or 2028-04-11 (morning PT)? If you prefer a different format, flag it and we can adjust.
